visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black T-shirt with a graphic print stands at a convenience store counter, gesturing dismissively towards a female clerk wearing a striped uniform. In the background, a person with long black hair is busy stocking shelves filled with colorful snack packages. The environment is a brightly lit indoor retail space with shelving and promotional posters. (2) The customer turns his body towards the person stocking shelves, pointing his finger and calling out. As that person turns around to reveal their face, the man's expression shifts to one of shock and awkwardness. He raises his hands in a defensive, apologetic gesture while the two clerks maintain a neutral gaze towards him. (3) A third male character dressed in a formal black suit with a pink shirt and tie walks into the frame, representing the store manager. The customer appears increasingly flustered, looking between the three staff members who are now all focused on him. He moves his arms erratically as if trying to backtrack his previous statements. (4) The visual editing cuts between several close-up reaction shots of the staff members' unimpressed faces. The customer is seen smiling nervously, waving his hands in a dismissive 'never mind' fashion, and physically backing away from the counter towards the exit. The lighting remains bright and consistent across all shots.

It focuses on the customer's incorrect assumptions about the staff's age and rank, leading to a sequence of embarrassing social blunders that culminate in the customer fleeing the scene.
